phoneSetup.title: Phone setup

oppo: Settings → Apps → Fame Fleet → Battery usage: turn on "Allow background activity" and "Allow auto launch".
Settings → Battery → More settings → Optimise battery use: Fame Fleet → "Don't optimise".
Recent apps: pull Fame Fleet down (or tap the lock) so it stays locked.
realme: Settings → Apps → Fame Fleet → Battery usage: turn on "Allow background activity" and "Allow auto launch".
Settings → Battery → App battery management: Fame Fleet → allow running in the background.
Recent apps: pull Fame Fleet down (or tap the lock) so it stays locked.
xiaomi: Settings → Apps → Fame Fleet: turn on "Autostart".
Recent apps: hold Fame Fleet and tap the lock.
vivo: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management: Fame Fleet → "Allow".
i Manager → App manager → Autostart: turn on Fame Fleet.
Recent apps: pull Fame Fleet down so it stays locked.
samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: Fame Fleet must not be in "Sleeping apps" or "Deep sleeping apps"; add it to "Never sleeping apps".
Recent apps: tap the Fame Fleet icon → "Keep open".
other: Settings → Apps → Fame Fleet → Battery: allow background activity, no restrictions.
If the phone has "Autostart" or "Auto launch", turn it on for Fame Fleet.
Recent apps: lock Fame Fleet so it stays open.
huawei: Settings → Battery → App launch → Fame Fleet: turn off "Manage automatically", then turn on all three switches.
Recent apps: pull Fame Fleet down (or tap the lock) so it stays locked.
